hero_title: Where Champions Are Raised with Love
hero_desc: Welcome to Kingdom of Snowstorm, an FCI-registered Bichon Frisé kennel based in Skopje, North Macedonia. Dedicated to raising healthy, loving, and extraordinary show-quality companions in the heart of our family.
box_desc: Officially registered under FCI No. 11/23 and MKD No. 268. Devoted to ethical, healthy, and championship preservation of the pure Bichon Frisé.
val1_desc: Our dogs are beloved family members first. They thrive surrounded by constant human touch, sound socialization, and endless daily cuddles.
val2_desc: Carefully planned matings following the FCI standard, safeguarding impeccable genetic health, sweet temperament, and dense white coats.
val3_desc: Proudly representing our kennel at World Dog Shows, European Championships, and FCI International competitions with C.I.B. titles.
